events.name: Bash
events.head: Check worktree state and probe scripts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-t299 && git log --oneline -3 && git status --short | head; tail -20 /tmp/t299/probes-summary.txt; echo ---; cat /tmp/t299/stack.sh; echo ---; cat /tmp/t299/run-probes.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check ports, day2 log, runner config
events.input: $ for p in 8930 8932 8934 8790 8791; do echo "$p: $(lsof -ti:$p -sTCP:LISTEN | tr '\n' ' ')"; done; ls -la /tmp/t299/probes-summary.txt /tmp/t299/stack.sh; tail -15 /tmp/t299/p-day2.log; grep -n 'RUNNER\|8790\|8791' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -20; grep -n '^LOCAL_RUNNER\|^RUNNER' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/.dev.vars | cut -c1-40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Probe which local ports answer
events.input: $ for p in 8930 8932 8934 8790 8791 8792 8794; do printf "$p: "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -m 3 http://127.0.0.1:$p/ ; done; ps -o pid,command -ax | grep -E 'wrangler dev|vendor-sim|runner' | grep -v grep | cut -c1-200 | head
